authority: These shapes refine opaque core v1 result bodies. They grant no origin/GO and are not yet proof of compatibility with a sealed core implementation.
remainingDynamicProof: All workers, compilation, load/invocation, safe failure continuation, timeout/reap, overflow, mutation rejection and actual kills are UNRUN.
